About.page_description: Meet the team of KED Global Logistics: Dawoud The Navi (Operations), Markus Long John Kempf (Business Development), Carlos Engel (Digital Services). Stuttgart, 20+ years of experience, our own UK network.
About.hero_description: A forwarding company from Stuttgart – owner-led, personal, technological. We combine classic forwarding expertise with consistent digitalization and a strong UK network.
About.story_p1: Behind KED Global Logistics stand three managing directors who have built decades of forwarding experience in Stuttgart, Europe and Great Britain.
About.story_p2: What sets us apart: short paths, personal contacts and a clear commitment to quality and digitalization. We operate our own Transport Management System, a customer portal and an exclusive UK network – so your shipments are transparent and predictable at all times.
About.story_image_alt: KED Global Logistics dispatch: staff at monitors with live tracking
About.team_description: Three profiles, three areas of responsibility – one shared line: logistics that delivers.

thenavi.name: Dawoud The Navi
thenavi.description: With over 20 years of international forwarding experience, Dawoud The Navi is responsible for the operational core of KED Global Logistics. His focus is on end-to-end process optimization, logistics automation and the consistent digitalization of all transport and warehouse operations. As the driving force behind the company's internationalization, he has built strategic partnerships – including the exclusive UK network with England Logistics in Witham and Stoke – and brought them to operational maturity. His areas of responsibility include dispatch, warehouse management, subcontractor coordination, quality management according to DIN EN ISO 9001, compliance (ADR/dangerous goods, customs clearance) and operational scaling for shipment volumes of up to 100,000 shipments per day.

kempf.name: Markus Long John Kempf
kempf.description: Markus Long John Kempf develops tailored logistics solutions for demanding industrial and commercial customers. As an expert in supply chain management, he designs holistic concepts that go far beyond classic transport: from supplier integration to warehouse strategies and last-mile delivery. His goal is to provide every customer with a predictable, transparent and scalable supply chain – integrated into their ERP systems, with real-time visibility and clear KPIs. In sales, he combines deep operational understanding with strategic consulting expertise.

engel.name: Carlos Engel
engel.description: Carlos Engel is responsible for digital transformation and the financial backbone of KED Global Logistics. As the interface between IT, Finance and Operations, he ensures that every shipment is seamlessly mapped not only physically but also digitally – from order entry through our proprietary Transport Management System (TMS) to DATEV-compliant invoicing. His responsibilities include IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, GDPR compliance, reporting and the continuous development of digital customer services such as the customer portal, live tracking and API integrations.

About.values_description: Five principles we measure ourselves against every day.

fast.title: Fast.
fast.description: Short response times, direct decision-making. With us you get a quote in under 24 hours – not in a week. Shipments are dispatched same-day, issues resolved immediately.

flexible.title: Flexible.
flexible.description: Express shipments, ADR, oversized cargo, direct delivery, refrigerated transport or crane goods – we solve what others reject. Our dispatch thinks ahead, not just by the book. Every inquiry is reviewed individually, every solution fits the customer.

transparent.title: Transparent.
transparent.description: You know where your goods are at all times. Live tracking via QR code, digital CMR documents, instant POD access in the customer portal. No phone calls needed – everything digital, always up to date.

digital.title: Digital.
digital.description: We use our own Transport Management System: from the first call to invoicing, fully digital. No Excel sheets, no paperwork, no media disruption. That saves time – yours and ours.

whatever.title: Whatever it takes.
whatever.description: This is more than a slogan. We take care of your entire supply chain – from supplier pickup to end customer delivery, including customs clearance, warehousing, cross-docking and returns. So you can focus on what matters: your growth.

About.cta_description: You can reach our management and dispatch directly – no call centre, no detours.
